capabilities.description: Ingest the Harbourline Contract and BOQ once, hash and version them, and expose the clauses and BOQ items (P1-P5, E1-E5, quantities, units, rates in SAR) as the authoritative reference every other capability reads from; gap-fills missing quantities as placeholders rather than inferring them.

Build interim payment certificates from measured BOQ quantities, price each item at its contract rate, apply the 5% retention per Clause 14.3, and release 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at end of Defects Notification Period; every claim line traces to a BOQ item and contract clause.

Track Time for Completion of 730 days from Commencement Date (Clause 8.2) and compute delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10% (Clause 8.7), with a running ledger of certified days, extensions and the cap position.

Maintain inspection and test plans (ITPs) and inspection records against BOQ/work packages, capturing hold points, results and sign-offs, and linking defects-liability items to the 365-day Defects Notification Period (Clause 11.1).

A governed register of project documents (drawings, ITPs, claims, correspondence) with revision control, status, transmittal history and retention, distinguishing the contract and BOQ as controlled source-of-record copies.

Extract and register the contract obligations and security positions — Performance Security at 10% of Accepted Contract Amount (Clause 4.2), retention, delay-damages cap, DNP — with dates, owners and escalation triggers, each cited to document:24f9a1ef2491488b81228abcbc171bf6_harbourline_contract.pd
